page.overview:
Who is Maudie?

She is the nursemaid of Harris, Hubert and Hamish. She is a plump woman with white headwear. Maudie is often afraid of the Triplets' behavior; mostly because they steal her desserts and scare her. pt-br:Maudie Category:Brave Characters
